doc: Frames (t_ms from the window's start, leg load in quiet-stand units, posture, tilt rad, gyro rad/s, the brain's vx) of policy set v9's walk network (= v7's) standing, cut from the 50 Hz neuro records of the V9Safety rigs (2026-11-10, live robotd 0.18.5 in the simulator, backlash body, 20 ms) and from its headless roam: 'false' ends where proprio claimed a pickup that nobody made (standing still on the floor, mostly with the beak resting on a thing); 'real' is the world's hand lifting the standing duck 2.0 s into the window; see neuro/seatcal.py.
